title: Private jet charter in Africa
description: Private flights in Africa: Johannesburg, Cape Town, Lagos and Marrakech, with airport rules and permits from official sources.
lead: Africa's gateways for private flights each set their own rules for permits and handling. Our guides start with Johannesburg, Cape Town, Lagos and Marrakech.

p: Many African countries ask foreign charter operators for a permit before the flight, and some airports require a handling agent for every private flight. The operator applies; we check the permits and the airports for your trip before you see a quote.
Our city guides cover Johannesburg, Cape Town, Lagos and Marrakech. More follow, each checked against official sources before it is published.

sections.h: Planning a trip across the continent
p: Distances in Africa are long, and many trips combine several countries. Each border on the route needs its own overflight or landing permission, and some airports open only at set hours or need a handling agent booked in advance. We plan the routing with the operator, check that every airport on it can take your aircraft at your times, and show you the plan with the quote.
Many travellers combine a business stop in Johannesburg or Lagos with time in Cape Town or Marrakech; we plan such trips as one journey with one operator where the aircraft and permits allow.
Your broker stays with you from the first enquiry to the last landing, and follows up after the trip.

We are a broker, not an airline, and we have no fixed routes. Tell us where you want to go and when, and we find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator and name it in your quote before you confirm. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.
